adjusted_prescription: To improve the policy’s ability to avoid hazards, it is important to include a demonstration that starts at the top-left corner and explicitly shows committing to the left-edge path when the top edge is dangerous due to fire hazards. This demo should begin by moving down one step from the start position, entering the left-edge corridor, and then continue following along the left edge and bottom row toward the goal. Doing so will provide a clear example of safely bypassing the fires that block the top edge without hesitating or attempting risky top-edge maneuvers. Including such a demonstration will teach the policy to prefer the left-edge corridor as a reliable, hazard-free path when the usual top-edge route is compromised. This will help the model generalize and consistently select safer routes in similar situations, reducing failures caused by hazardous top-edge proximity.
